title: Actual state (topic ul/v1/d/{id}/state/{out}, retained, QoS 1, device to server)
description: What the output is doing. Published after a set or live message is applied (at most 5 per second per output while a live stream runs, and always once when it settles), after a local change such as a button, and once per output after every connect. seq and src echo the message that caused it; local changes use src 'device' and seq 0.

pulse_ms_left.description: solenoid only: time left in the current pulse.

mode.description: cycle only: the selected mode, kept while off.

at.description: cycle only: where the device believes the appliance is now (it counts presses). While it differs from the target (on ? mode : off) the servo is still pressing.
